title: Prove the logged clause in the proof checker's SMT fallback
summary: The proof replay's SMT fallback now refutes the negation of the logged clause alone, instead of a condition that also contained the hint's clause, so a tautological hint can no longer make a satisfiable clause pass as verified. A plugin's shortcut condition is used only after the logged clause is shown to follow from the hint's clause, and the 'is not rup' diagnostic is printed only on rejected steps.
